Name: MythicFenix's Mystical Hares for 1.6
Author: silvermoonchan
Description:
With permission from MythicFenix, I've updated their Mystical Hares (found [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3681]here[/url])to work with SVD 1.6. Credit for the original mod goes to MythicFenix.

Mythical Hares come in four varieties. They live in coops and produce wool and rabbit's feet like the regular rabbits.

Enjoy!
